top_choice_rationale: P002 rewards a checkable theory-to-experiment chain: the 2011 Bistritzer-MacDonald prediction of flat bands at a magic angle and the 2018 observation of correlated insulating and superconducting states there, since reproduced by many independent groups and now the design principle for moire quantum matter. The pairing mechanism is a follow-up question, not part of the citation. Maturity and the omission of Cao are real costs, so P003 and P001, with about two decades of confirmation, follow closely behind.
